duration_note: Approximate playback duration from last packet timestamp. WebM does not provide a format-duration field.
frame_rate_note: Not independently verified; the browser UI showed 30 fps, while raw format metadata does not provide a trustworthy frame-rate field.
filename_timestamp_note: Derived from the original filename's epoch milliseconds; may denote recording creation or export, not necessarily start time.
provenance: Original user-uploaded annotated recording; bytes copied without modification.
